# R library and packages

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

```

## Prepare data frame and calculating FD dimension

```{r}

df <- data.frame(s=c(500,450,400,350,300,250,200,150,100,50),
                 N=c(228,281,343,432,568,789,1176,1981,4083,13205))

df <- df %>% 
  mutate(ln_inv_s =log(1/s),
         ln_N=log(N))

model <- lm(ln_N~ln_inv_s, data = df)
summary(model)

```
# Assess confidence interval on the slope and intercept

```{r}
CI <- confint(model, level = 0.95)
CI
```

#Assess residual distribution

```{r}

names(model)
residuals <- model$residuals
mean(residuals)

qqnorm(residuals)
qqline(residuals, col = "red", lwd = 2)

plot(model$fitted.values,
     residuals,
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted values")

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lwd = 2)
lines(lowess(model$fitted.values, residuals), col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2)
plot(model)

```

# Calculate RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error)

```{r}

rmse <- sqrt(mean(residuals^2))
rmse

```

# Plot the residuals values

```{r}

graph <- ggplot(model, aes(x = model$fitted.values, y = model$residuals)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#B22222", linewidth = 0.9, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#1B7837", 
              fill = "#1B7837", alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1, span = 1) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.8, 
             fill = "white", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title    = "Residuals vs. fitted values",
    subtitle = "Box-counting regression diagnostic",
    x        = "Fitted values (ln N(s) predicted)",
    y        = "Residuals"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text       = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border    = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6)
  )
graph

```

# Apply Local Moran's I (Spatial Weight Matrix (W)- Queen Contiguity) on grid polygon

```{r}
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(tmap)
library(tidyverse)
# setwd()

occupiedPoly <- st_read('localSpatialClustering.shp')
occupiedPoly <-occupiedPoly %>%
  rename(mean_FD=mean)
occupiedPoly <-occupiedPoly %>% 
  mutate(mean_FD=round(mean_FD,2))

# Run Local Moran's I

nb <- poly2nb(occupiedPoly,queen = FALSE)
card(nb)
summary(nb)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
local <- localmoran(
          occupiedPoly$mean_FD,
          lw,
          zero.policy = TRUE)
head(local)

# add Z-value, p-value and observed statistics

occupiedPoly$Ii <- local[,1]
occupiedPoly$Z <- local[,4]
occupiedPoly$pvalue <- local[,5]

# calculate standardized FD

occupiedPoly$FD_lag <- lag.listw(lw, occupiedPoly$mean_FD, zero.policy = TRUE)

# Standardize FD and its lag (mean-centered)
occupiedPoly$FD_std <- scale(occupiedPoly$mean_FD)[, 1]
occupiedPoly$FD_lag_std <- scale(occupiedPoly$FD_lag)[, 1]

# Significance threshold
sig_level <- 0.05

occupiedPoly <- occupiedPoly %>%
  mutate(cluster = case_when(
    pvalue > sig_level                      ~ "Not significant",
    FD_std > 0 & FD_lag_std > 0            ~ "High-High",
    FD_std < 0 & FD_lag_std < 0            ~ "Low-Low",
    FD_std > 0 & FD_lag_std < 0            ~ "High-Low",
    FD_std < 0 & FD_lag_std > 0            ~ "Low-High",
    TRUE                                   ~ "Not significant"
  ))

table(occupiedPoly$cluster)
 
# False Discovery Rate (FDR) correction instead of raw p < 0.05
occupiedPoly$Pval_fdr <- p.adjust(occupiedPoly$pvalue, method = "fdr")
occupiedPoly<- occupiedPoly %>%
  mutate(cluster_fdr = case_when(
    Pval_fdr > sig_level                   ~ "Not significant",
    FD_std > 0 & FD_lag_std > 0            ~ "High-High",
    FD_std < 0 & FD_lag_std < 0            ~ "Low-Low",
    FD_std > 0 & FD_lag_std < 0            ~ "High-Low",
    FD_std < 0 & FD_lag_std > 0            ~ "Low-High",
    TRUE                                   ~ "Not significant"
  ))
table(occupiedPoly$cluster_fdr)

# visualise the cluster
majorRd <- st_read("major_road_networks.shp")
majorRd <- majorRd %>% 
  select(-mink_dem)
majorRd <- majorRd %>% st_transform(crs = 32646)

tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(occupiedPoly) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "cluster",
    palette = c("High-High" = "#d7191c",
                "Low-Low" = "#2c7bb6",
                "Low-High" = "#abd9e9",
                "High-Low" = "#fdae61",
                "Not significant" = "grey90"),
    title = "LISA Cluster",
    border.col = "grey40",
    border.alpha = 0.5,
    lwd = 0.3
  ) +

  tm_shape(majorRd) +
  tm_lines(
    lwd = 1.3,
    col = "black",
    lty = "solid"
  ) +
  tm_text(
    text = "Name",
    size = 0.4,
    col = "black",
    shadow = TRUE,
    auto.placement = TRUE,
    remove.overlap = TRUE
  ) +

  tm_layout(
    main.title = "Local Moran's I Cluster Map",
    main.title.size = 1,
    main.title.position = "center",
    legend.position = c("left", "bottom"),
    legend.title.size = 0.9,
    legend.text.size = 0.6,
    legend.bg.color = "white",
    legend.bg.alpha = 0.8,
    legend.frame = FALSE,
    frame = TRUE,
    inner.margins = c(0.08, 0.08, 0.08, 0.08)
  ) +

  tm_scalebar(
    breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
    text.size = 0.6,
    lwd = 0.5,
    position = c("right", "bottom")
  ) +

  tm_compass(
    type = "4star",
    lwd = 2,
    size = 2,
    position = c("right", "top")
  )

st_write(occupiedPoly, 'localSpatialClustering.shp')

```
